title: Task-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning for MoE-based Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.13395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has become a widely adopted architecture for Large Language Models (LLMs), as it improves model capacity while limiting computational overhead through sparse expert activation. This property makes MoE-based LLMs particularly attractive for resource-constrained distributed environments. However, federated fine-tuning of MoE-based LLMs remains challenging under heterogeneous client data. Since clients often correspond to different task preferences, directly aggregating their local updates may weaken expert specialization and introduce conflicting update directions on shared experts. To address these challenges, we propose FedTAR, a task-aware federated fine-tuning method for MoE-based LLMs. FedTAR establishes the association between local updates and task preference via routing outputs. translated_title: 面向基于混合专家（MoE）大语言模型的任务感知联邦微调
translated_abstract: 混合专家（MoE）已成为大语言模型（LLM）中被广泛采用的架构，它通过稀疏专家激活在提升模型容量的同时限制计算开销。这一特性使得基于MoE的大语言模型在资源受限的分布式环境中尤为具有吸引力。然而，在客户端数据异构的情况下，对基于MoE的大语言模型进行联邦微调仍然充满挑战。由于客户端通常对应不同的任务偏好，直接聚合它们的本地更新可能会削弱专家的专业化能力，并在共享专家上引入冲突的更新方向。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了FedTAR，一种面向基于MoE大语言模型的任务感知联邦微调方法。FedTAR通过路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好之间的关联。具体而言，我们对路由特征和本地更新应用奇异值分解（SVD），以提取低维度的……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出FedTAR，一种面向基于MoE大语言模型的任务感知联邦微调方法，通过路由输出建立本地更新与任务偏好的关联，并利用奇异值分解（SVD）解决异构客户端数据下专家专业化弱化和更新方向冲突的问题。
en_tdlr: FedTAR is a task-aware federated fine-tuning method for MoE-based LLMs that associates local updates with task preferences via routing outputs and applies SVD to mitigate weakened expert specialization and conflicting updates under heterogeneous client data.
